function: PPO agent sets BS stream powers, common-rate split, and IRS phase shifts (beam directions by MRT/ZF) to maximize ISAC energy efficiency under QoS constraints (p. 4).
system: ULA BS (M = 4 to 8), K = 2 single-antenna users, one moving target, reflecting IRS (N up to 36, 2-bit), 1.4-2.4 GHz (p. 4-5).
method: PPO deep reinforcement learning (DNN policy, clipped surrogate objective, SGD) trained by interaction with the simulated environment; reward is EE with constraint penalties (p. 4).
data_channel: Custom 3D geometry-based simulator of BS-IRS-user/target links: Rician LoS plus CN(0,1) NLoS, Doppler, double-Rician and double-Rayleigh fading; no 3GPP model or measured data (p. 2, p. 5).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in the same simulated environment; EE swept over BS antennas, IRS elements, carrier frequency, RCS and fading; no unseen-condition test stated (p. 5).
baselines: Random and Greedy action schemes, and an SDMA-IRS-assisted ISAC benchmark; no earlier learned method or other DRL algorithm compared (p. 5).
metrics: Energy efficiency (bit/Hz/J), average reward, per-user achievable rate, radar echo SNR (p. 5).
complexity: Time complexity approximately O(sum over layers of neurons in layer l-1 times neurons in layer l) for Algorithm 1 (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 1: "we establish a geometry-based channel model" (the authors' own 3D model with Rician and Rayleigh fading; no 3GPP TR 38.901/38.811, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used).
q2_support: p. 5: "EE versus the number of BS antennas for varying the channel conditions" (EE is swept over BS antennas, IRS elements, frequency, RCS and fading, but no trained model is tested on an unseen scenario or adapted).
q3_support: p. 5: "the Random and Greedy approaches are adopted as baseline methods for comparison" (non-learned baselines on EE; no earlier learned method or other DRL algorithm is compared, and the SDMA benchmark of Fig. 4 is not stated to be learned).
q4_support: p. 4: "complexity is approximately O" (Algorithm 1: O of the sum over the L layers of the neuron counts of consecutive layers).
q5_support: p. 4: "the simulation parameters are based on [9] and [10]" (custom simulator; no code or data link or public dataset is given anywhere in the paper).
notes: Read all 5 pages and page 5 as an image (Figs. 2-4, legends and axes). Included: research article, learned (PPO) physical-layer control, simulation results, BS with M antennas and an IRS. Area 5: the PPO agent controls powers, rate split and IRS phases that serve sensing and communication in an ISAC system; area 5 wins over area 3 by the tie-break order. The direction parts of the user beamformers come from MRT/ZF (p. 3-4) and the paper omits the derivations of vc, vr and u (p. 4). q3 is 0 only because the learned side is missing: Random and Greedy are non-learned heuristics, and the paper does not say whether Greedy or SDMA uses learning; if the reviewer reads Greedy as a learned myopic agent, q3 would change. q4 is met by the stated O(...) of Algorithm 1 in neurons per layer.
